name: WelcomeIntro
en: Locks your PC when you're gone, knows when you're still using it, and can pause, mute, open or close apps and more until you're back.
ar: يُقفل SteppedOut الكمبيوتر عندما تكون بعيدًا عنه، ولا يُقفله وأنت ما زلت تستخدمه. ويمكنه إيقاف الموسيقى مؤقتًا وكتم الصوت حتى تعود، وفتح التطبيقات وإغلاقها، وغير ذلك.
where: Welcome window, page 1: the line under Welcome to SteppedOut

name: Start
where: Welcome window, page 1: the one button, which goes to page 2

name: Back
where: Welcome window, the footer of pages 2 to 5: the page before

name: Skip
where: Welcome window, the footer of pages 2 to 4: the next page, keeping this page's choices

name: Next
where: Welcome window, the footer of pages 2 to 4: the next page

name: StepOf
where: Welcome window, the footer, after the step dots; {0} is 1 to 4 and {1} is 4

name: Countdown15
where: Welcome window, page 2, Warn me before it locks: the countdown choice

name: NoWarning
where: Welcome window, page 2, Warn me before it locks: no countdown; also the timeline's Warning stop when there is none

name: StillUsing
where: Welcome window, page 3 heading

name: StillUsingIntro
en: The PC can be in use without the mouse or keyboard, like when music or video plays, you're on a call, or an app is full screen. Extra time adds to the lock time.
ar: قد تستخدم الكمبيوتر دون لمس الماوس أو لوحة المفاتيح، مثل تشغيل الموسيقى أو الفيديو أو إجراء مكالمة أو استخدام تطبيق في وضع ملء الشاشة. يُضاف الوقت الإضافي إلى مهلة القفل ولا يحل محلها.
where: Welcome window, page 3: the line under the heading

name: AppRulesBox
where: Welcome window, page 3: the title of the box at the end

name: AppRulesBoxText
en: Make the PC lock sooner, later or never while an app you pick is open. Set this in Settings > Locking.
ar: يمكنك تقليل مهلة القفل أو إطالتها أو منع القفل عندما يكون تطبيق تختاره مفتوحًا. لإضافة قاعدة، افتح إعدادات SteppedOut > القفل.
where: Welcome window, page 3: the box at the end, under Rules for specific apps

name: AwayAndBack
where: Welcome window, page 4 heading; also a group in What you picked

name: AppsAndScripts
where: Welcome window, page 4: the title of the box under the four tiles

name: AppsAndScriptsText
en: Open or close apps, or run scripts, automatically when you leave or come back. Set this in Settings > Away and back.
ar: يمكنك فتح التطبيقات وإغلاقها وتشغيل برامج نصية تلقائيًا عند المغادرة أو العودة. لإعدادها، افتح إعدادات SteppedOut > المغادرة والعودة.
where: Welcome window, page 4: the box under the four tiles, under Apps and scripts

name: YoureSet
where: Welcome window, page 5 heading

name: TrayStep1
ar: انقر على السهم ^ بجوار الساعة لإظهار الأيقونات المخفية.
where: Welcome window, page 5: step 1 under the taskbar picture

name: TrayStep2
ar: أيقونة القفل في القائمة هي أيقونة SteppedOut.
where: Welcome window, page 5: step 2 under the taskbar picture

name: TrayStep3
en: Drag it onto the taskbar to keep it in sight.
ar: اسحبها إلى شريط المهام لتبقى ظاهرة.
where: Welcome window, page 5: step 3 under the taskbar picture

name: WhatYouPicked
where: Welcome window, page 5: the title of the summary of every choice

name: RightNow
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the small title beside the drawn PC

name: LocksAfter
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3, under Right now: the lock time with what is ticked; {0} is a time such as 45 minutes

name: NeverLocksDuring
where: Welcome window, page 3, under Right now, while something ticked never locks; {0} is during music or video, during a call, in full screen or on battery power

name: BatterySooner
en: On battery, all times are {0}% sooner.
ar: على البطارية، تصبح مهلة القفل والوقت الإضافي أقصر بنسبة {0}%.
where: Welcome window, page 3, under Right now, while On battery is ticked and the battery choice is a percent sooner; {0} is 1 to 95

name: MusicOrVideoToggle
where: Welcome window, page 3: the toggle beside the drawn PC that previews music or video playing

name: CallToggle
where: Welcome window, page 3: the toggle beside the drawn PC that previews a call

name: FullScreenToggle
where: Welcome window, page 3: the toggle beside the drawn PC that previews an app full screen

name: OnBatteryToggle
where: Welcome window, page 3: the toggle beside the drawn PC that previews the laptop unplugged; also its mark on the drawn laptop

name: StopIdle
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the timeline's first stop

name: StopWarning
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the timeline's stop for the countdown

name: StopLocks
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the timeline's stop where the PC locks

name: StopAway
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the timeline's stop after the lock

name: StopBack
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the timeline's last stop

name: LocksInstantly
where: Welcome window, page 2: the timeline's note while a lock shortcut is chosen; {0} is the shortcut, such as Ctrl+Alt+L

name: NeverLocks
where: Welcome window, page 3: the timeline's note on the striped bar while something ticked never locks

name: Play
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the button beside Right now that walks through the timeline's moments

name: StopPlaying
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: the Play button while it plays

name: MomentIdle
en: The lock time starts counting from here.
ar: تبدأ مهلة القفل من آخر استخدام للماوس أو لوحة المفاتيح.
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: beside the drawn PC when You stop using the PC is the moment shown

name: MomentLocks
ar: يُقفل الكمبيوتر تلقائيًا دون أن تفعل شيئًا.
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: beside the drawn PC when Locks is the moment shown

name: MomentAway
en: SteppedOut can pause music, mute the PC and more.
ar: يمكن أن يوقف SteppedOut الموسيقى مؤقتًا ويكتم الصوت وغير ذلك.
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: beside the drawn PC when You're away is the moment shown

name: MomentBack
en: Unlock the PC as usual, and what was paused can play again.
ar: تفتح القفل كالمعتاد، ويمكن أن يُستأنف تشغيل ما أُوقف مؤقتًا.
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: beside the drawn PC when You're back is the moment shown

name: Timeline
where: Welcome window, pages 2 and 3: what a screen reader calls the timeline under the drawn PC

name: Situations
where: Welcome window, page 3: what a screen reader calls the four toggles beside the drawn PC

name: SoonerFieldName
where: Welcome window, page 3, On battery power, Custom… box: what a screen reader calls the box; {0} is On battery power
